purpose: Real Bridgeport institutions named by the city lore (core/data/fictional-city/district.v1.json, expansionBusinesses[].realInstitution). Geography agents bind footprints to these records; lore carries parcel IDs only, never coordinates.
coordinateNote: lon/lat are WGS84 from the U.S. Census Bureau geocoder (Public_AR_Current benchmark), which interpolates along the street address range. They locate the address on the street, not the building footprint or entrance; bind the footprint from the CT 2023 building layer and record that source separately.

institutions.gameRules: Real identity only. No payoff interaction, invented officer, rank, slogan, policy or misconduct. In-game staff are fictional civilians.

officialName.note: Bridgeport Public Schools' school site and the district's school menu (https://www.bridgeportedu.net/schools) name it Harding High School. 45 Lyon Terrace is the district office and is not used.

institutions.gameRules: Real identity only. Its principal and real staff and students are not portrayed; in-game staff and students are fictional. No payoff interaction. The private-school gang that harasses its students is named for Bond Street.
